# Navimower Map Card 0.3.4-beta5

- Adds a gear-button Settings dialog to the card header.
- The visual card editor can select up to 12 Home Assistant entities for the Settings dialog; the card renders them in a responsive two-column grid and opens native More Info when tapped.
- Adds a Navimower-managed scheduler overview backed by Navimower 0.4.3-beta35+ `schedule status` data.
- Scheduler zones are shown as completed, active, or upcoming; completed rows are muted and the active row uses Navimower orange.
- The Schedule button opens the Navimower-managed overview while that scheduler is enabled.
- When the Navimower-managed scheduler is off, the existing native mower schedule editor remains the entry point. This also applies when both schedulers are off, so native scheduling can be configured directly.
